prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1478; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's fine.
Q: Understood. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision?
A: Yes, I was driving.
Q: Where were you when the collision happened?
A: On a two-lane road in Conroe, Texas, heading toward the shopping center. It was a pretty slow stretch.
Q: What was the weather and road condition like?
A: Dry, and it was daylight. Nothing unusual.
Q: How fast were you traveling before the impact?
A: Not much faster than walking pace, maybe creeping along because of the traffic backing up ahead.
Q: Describe what happened.
A: The other car came over into my lane. It was a head-on, but really a glancing kind of hit, both of us braking. It didn't feel like a big crash.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't.
Q: What injuries did you sustain?
A: I fractured my wrist. I put my hand out on the steering wheel and felt it give. I've got a cast now and I'm seeing a specialist next week.
Q: Did you seek medical attention at the scene or afterward?
A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room that same day. They X-rayed it and set it.
Q: Have you had any prior injuries to the same wrist?
A: No, not to that wrist.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I'm still having trouble gripping things, and I'm worried about how long recovery will take.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thanks.
